criteria.description: Walls, counters, chairs, workstations, floors, and camera can physically coexist.
criteria.label: Room geometry

criteria.description: Declared movement paths remain safe, visible, and unobstructed.
criteria.label: Circulation

criteria.description: Doors, walls, counters, windows, seating, and workstations remain stable.
criteria.label: Spatial anchors

criteria.description: A wide master establishes geography that all closer coverage preserves.
criteria.label: Master and coverage

criteria.description: Speaking principals remain identifiable and no person is duplicated or fused.
criteria.label: Character count and identity

criteria.description: Occupancy and crowd placement stay within the planned range.
criteria.label: Background population

criteria.description: Background people do not abruptly duplicate, disappear, intersect objects, or stare at the action.
criteria.label: Crowd continuity

criteria.description: Positions, scale, screen direction, and framing follow the shot plan.
criteria.label: Blocking and framing
criteria.notes: The card rapidly fills the foreground and converts a subtle side insert into a hero-prop presentation.

criteria.description: Actors look at planned story targets and never into the camera.
criteria.label: Gaze and eyeline
criteria.notes: The nurse becomes near-frontal and the background patient does not clearly glance toward his pocket.

criteria.description: Hands, feet, limbs, body contact, and object contact are plausible.
criteria.label: Anatomy and contact

criteria.description: Buttons, pockets, sleeves, closures, and accessories remain coherent.
criteria.label: Wardrobe construction
criteria.notes: The nurse changes to a blue uniform without the established teal scrubs and open grey cardigan.

criteria.description: Props keep their shape, colour, owner, and planned location.
criteria.label: Prop identity and ownership
criteria.notes: The card grows from ordinary proportions into an oversized foreground rectangle.

criteria.description: Handoffs and manipulation preserve physical contact and object identity.
criteria.label: Prop interaction
criteria.notes: The handoff turns into holding the card outward rather than returning it naturally across the counter.

criteria.description: Protected identifiers, card faces, and monitor content remain unreadable.
criteria.label: Privacy

criteria.description: No malformed or unnecessary words, letters, numbers, signs, captions, or watermarks appear.
criteria.label: Unwanted text

criteria.description: Light direction, colour, and time of day remain coherent.
criteria.label: Lighting continuity

criteria.description: Facial performance and physical action fit the dialogue and dramatic beat.
criteria.label: Performance and action
criteria.notes: The card moment is underlined and the patient's wallet/pocket recognition is absent.

criteria.description: Dialogue audio remains synchronized with its generated picture.
criteria.label: Audio and lip sync

criteria.description: Faces, wardrobe, location, props, narrative facts, and screen direction remain stable.
criteria.label: Continuity
criteria.notes: Nurse wardrobe and prop scale do not match the accepted master/prop plan.

criteria.description: Meaning comes from restrained light, colour, distance, architecture, and sparse text-free symbols.
criteria.label: Symbolic environment
criteria.notes: The oversized card becomes explanatory imagery instead of quiet environmental foreshadowing.

criteria.description: The target occupancy is between 50% and 70%.
criteria.label: Location occupancy

criteria.description: No patient information is planned to be visible.
criteria.label: Patient information policy

criteria.description: The workstation monitor faces away from or is occluded from camera.
criteria.label: Monitor orientation

criteria.description: The counter maintains at least 0.8 metres between public and staff positions.
criteria.label: Counter separation

criteria.description: Location screens are never readable.
criteria.label: Profile screen privacy

criteria.description: Health-card faces are never readable.
criteria.label: Profile card privacy
